title: Language Program
description: Defines the required metadata structure for every language program in the Sauti Labs platform, per the Sauti Codex Layer 2 specification.

language_name.description: The common English name of the language, e.g. 'Kiswahili'.

iso_code.description: ISO 639 language code, e.g. 'sw' for Kiswahili.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the language program.

countries.description: Countries where the language is primarily spoken.

datasets.description: Identifiers of datasets belonging to this language program, cross-referenced in the Codex Layer 3.

models.description: Identifiers of models trained for this language, cross-referenced in the Codex Layer 4.
